caption: A gust of wind reaches a row of wind turbines on a hill, and the blades start turning and speed up.

sa.check: A row of wind turbines stands on a hill.
A gust of wind reaches them.
The gust comes first and the turning follows.

pc.expect: The blades begin turning only when the wind arrives and slow when it drops.
pc.fail: They turn in still air; or the wind arrives and they stay still; or they keep speeding up after the wind drops.
They reach full speed instantly; or reverse; or jerk.

pc.expect: All the turbines turn the same way.
pc.fail: They turn in opposite directions; or one stays still while the others spin in the same wind; or they turn erratically.
They bend like cloth; or detach; or stretch.
A turbine vanishes; or appears; or a blade vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The turbines and the hill stay the same.
pc.fail: The turbines change colour; or the hill rearranges; or the sky changes.
